scene.speaker: ingrid
scene.bubble: When the lights went out at the sports centre, everyone was doing something different. Let's find out what!
scene.intro: When the lights went out at the sports centre, everybody was doing something. Ingrid was practising her jump. Maya was swimming in the pool, and she didn't notice for a whole minute. Somebody was blowing a whistle in the dark and two children were laughing in the changing room. Nobody was scared — well, almost nobody. What were YOU doing at eight o'clock yesterday?

activities.title: Listen. What was everyone doing at 6 o'clock? Write a word in each gap.

data.script: Maya: So, Ingrid — at six o'clock the lights went out. What were you doing? … Ingrid: I was swimming in the pool. It was very dark and very funny! … Maya: And Oliver? … Ingrid: He was practising basketball on the court. He was carrying three balls! … Maya: What about Diego? … Ingrid: He was interviewing the trainer next to the gym. … Maya: And the little kids? … Ingrid: They were shouting happily in the dark — they thought it was a game! … Maya: And Kili? … Ingrid: Ha! He was sleeping on the roof. He didn't notice anything!

Ingrid is reading the plan for the day. … Diego: And who is the girl in the green shirt with a magnifying glass? … Maya: That is Maya. Look, Maya is looking at something very small. … Diego: And who is the boy with red hair and a yellow shirt? … Maya: That is Oliver. Look, Oliver is singing. … Diego: And who is the girl with black plaits and a purple shirt? … Maya: That is Lia.
